kjv.text: And my spirit hath rejoiced in God my Saviour.

bsb.text: and my spirit rejoices in God my Savior!

web.text: My spirit has rejoiced in God my Savior,

leads.kjv: And my soul shall be joyful in the LORD: it shall rejoice in his salvation.
For this is good and acceptable in the sight of God our Saviour;
Yet I will rejoice in the LORD, I will joy in the God of my salvation.

flow.say: Henry shows how Mary rejoiced in God as her own Saviour, not just as the mother of the Messiah.
She understood that even she needed Christ as her Saviour, just like all other believers do.
This spiritual joy comes from having Christ as both God and Saviour.

morning.say: Carry into today the truth that having Christ as your Saviour gives you real reason to rejoice in spirit.
morning.phrase: Those that have Christ for their God and Saviour have a great deal of reason to rejoice
